channel.title: Open Signal
channel.description: Checked open calls for electronic and experimental musicians.

item.title: DCMF Songwriter and Producer Residencies 2027
item.description: Canadian songwriters and producers can apply for concurrent month-long January residencies with furnished housing and access to Goldensides recording studio and equipment. Deadline: 22 Oct 2026, 06:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. The organizer provides housing, studio access, and airport pickup but does not state an artist stipend, travel funding to Yukon, food support, or production budget.

item.title: Norman Music Festival 2027 performer applications
item.description: Apply for one of more than 200 sets at the free downtown festival in Norman, Oklahoma, running 22–24 April 2027. Deadline: 24 Oct 2026, 04:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee. The organizer does not state artist compensation or travel support on the application page.

item.title: Tallinn Music Week 2027 artist applications
item.description: Artists of any genre and country may apply to perform at the 8–10 April 2027 discovery festival in Tallinn. Deadline: 26 Oct 2026, 21:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. Selected artists receive festival and conference passes; the source does not state a performance fee or travel support.

item.title: SPOT Festival 2027 artist applications
item.description: Nordic newcomers can apply to perform at the discovery-focused festival in Aarhus on 7–8 May 2027. Deadline: 31 Oct 2026, 11:00 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. The organizer does not state application costs, artist compensation, or travel support on the public call page; confirm before committing.

item.title: STIAS Artist-in-Residence Fellowship
item.description: A fully supported 2028 fellowship for an interdisciplinary creative project, including return economy travel, accommodation, a monthly living stipend, weekday lunch, and workspace. Deadline: 31 Oct 2026, 23:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. Designed for established artists with an outstanding public track record; STIAS has no specialized studios, and fellows arrange their own health insurance.

item.title: TURN UP Multimedia Festival 2027
item.description: Submit acoustic, electroacoustic, fixed-media, live-electronic, installation, immersive, or multimedia work for the 15–17 April 2027 festival. Deadline: 02 Nov 2026, 06:59 UTC. Cost: No submission fee stated; selected artists encouraged to contribute US $70. Selected artists must attend in Tucson. There is no travel stipend or honorarium, local performers are not guaranteed, and the $70 contribution is encouraged rather than stated as mandatory.

item.title: Sound and Music In Motion 2027
item.description: An 18-month programme for up to ten music and sound creators, with a £1,800 bursary, up to £4,000 for production, coaching, mentoring, and peer support. Deadline: 02 Nov 2026, 23:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. The £4,000 production grant cannot be used to pay the selected creator a commission fee; the separate £1,800 bursary supports participation.

item.title: European Media Artists in Residence 2027
item.description: A two-month production residency with €4,000 for the applying artist, €2,000 for a collaborator, a €4,000 project budget, accommodation, travel, and host facilities. Deadline: 06 Nov 2026, 13:00 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. A collaborator is required, though one can be identified after selection; the €4,000 artist grant includes subsistence during the two-month residency.

item.title: Sounds of the Future Residency
item.description: A three-week residency with a DKK 30,000 work grant, studio and equipment access, and accommodation. Deadline: 06 Nov 2026, 22:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. Application portal is unavailable until 1 November during Koda's system transition.

item.title: Avatar Emerging Artists Residency 2027
item.description: A two-week creation residency with a CAD $2,700 artist fee, up to 28 hours of technical support, production facilities, and a CAD $550 fee for the public sharing. Deadline: 09 Nov 2026, 04:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. The residency is limited to local emerging artists; travel, accommodation, and materials support are not stated.

item.title: Bears in the Park Sound Residency 2027
item.description: Vienna-based musicians and sound artists can request two weeks to several months of free project space with a basic sound system, electricity, and internet. Deadline: 15 Nov 2026, 22:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee; studio provided free. No artist fee, travel, accommodation, or materials support is stated; this is workspace for artists already based in Vienna.

item.title: Jack Straw New Media Gallery Program 2027–28
item.description: Sound-led installation residencies include an exhibition of up to three months, 20 hours with an engineer, production equipment, two public events, and an interview podcast. Deadline: 24 Nov 2026, 07:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. There is no artist fee; the program provides a US $500 expense budget, and artists whose physical presence is required must cover travel and accommodation not stated by the organizer.

item.title: A Gift Without Name compilation
item.description: Submit a sound work responding to the 'A Gift Without Name' theme for a free/name-your-price digital compilation due 4 December 2026. Deadline: 29 Nov 2026, 23:59 UTC. Cost: No fee. No royalties or other payment. Artists keep ownership, grant no exclusivity, and can request removal.

item.title: Musikfonds small project funding
item.description: Apply for up to €3,000 toward a January–March 2027 music project in a rural or structurally weak area, or in public space. Deadline: 30 Nov 2026, 17:00 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. Projects need at least 10% co-financing. Total project cost cannot exceed €10,000; purchases and projects outside Germany are ineligible.

item.title: Bernheim Artist in Residence 2027
item.description: A six-to-eight-week nature-focused residency with a US $2,500 stipend, rustic housing, studio space, and staff support; sound and performance art are explicitly eligible. Deadline: 01 Dec 2026, 04:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. Travel and visa support are not stated; residents donate a site-inspired artwork, temporary installation, or project to the Bernheim Foundation and take part in public engagement.

item.title: Voetvolk Atelier Rubigny artist residencies 2027
item.description: One-week rural residencies for artists, collectives, and companies include accommodation, a sound-equipped studio, and up to €500 in documented project support. Deadline: 01 Dec 2026, 22:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. Financial support is reimbursement-based and capped at €500 per project; travel and meals are not stated, and the rural venue is not accessible by public transport.

item.title: Odjeci Sound Art Fellowship — Spring 2027
item.description: A two-week spring sound-art fellowship in rural Bosnia and Herzegovina, with a €500 fee, accommodation, studio access, production support, mentorship, and documentation. Deadline: 01 Dec 2026, 22:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. Travel, food, and materials are not covered; the organizer provides a €500 artist fee, room, workspace, technical support, and mentorship.

item.title: European Music Collective at Kintai Music Festival
item.description: Composers may propose an unpremiered work for the ensemble; composer-performers with improvisation experience may also join the 1–9 August 2027 festival. Deadline: 01 Dec 2026, 23:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated; selected participants pay €25. There is no composition or performance fee. Composer-performers receive accommodation, but travel, meals, and local expenses are not covered; selected participants pay €25.

item.title: Wave Farm Research and Production Program 2027
item.description: Apply through one form for ten-day transmission or spatial-sound residencies paying US $1,000, or two-month radio-art fellowships paying US $2,000. Deadline: 02 Dec 2026, 04:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. Residents and fellows pay their own travel, meals, and materials; accommodation is provided, with local pickup available from specified transport hubs.

item.title: Play NXNE 2027
item.description: Apply for a showcase at NXNE in Toronto, 16–20 June 2027; every submission is reviewed by the programming team. Deadline: 01 Jan 2027, 04:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee. Selected acts choose a CAD $150 band / $100 solo fee or an artist VIP package; travel and lodging support are not stated.

item.title: New York City Electroacoustic Music Festival 2027
item.description: Submit fixed-media, live-electronic, mixed, multimedia or installation work for the 15–21 June 2027 festival. Deadline: 01 Jan 2027, 04:59 UTC. Cost: No submission fee; about US $350 mandatory if accepted. Important: accepted artists must pay an approximately US $350 registration fee whether or not they attend; performers and large instruments cost extra. Students may qualify for 50% off.

item.title: Alternating Currents 2027 artist applications
item.description: Musicians and other creatives can propose performances or projects for the 12–15 August 2027 festival across the Quad Cities. Deadline: 01 Jan 2027, 05:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee. Compensation is offered but varies by project and scope; travel and lodging support are not stated on the call page.

item.title: Vaughan Williams Foundation general funding
item.description: Funding for performances, commissions, recordings, festivals, and composer-development projects, with indicative grants from £750 to £10,000 depending on category. Deadline: 05 Jan 2027, 23:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. The foundation funds no more than 50% of a project's total cost, so applicants need a credible plan for the balance; projects must start at least three months after the deadline.

item.title: Koussevitzky Foundation Commissioning Program 2027
item.description: Performing organizations may propose a composer for a US $10,000–$15,000 chamber commission or up to US $20,000 toward a symphonic commission. Deadline: 16 Jan 2027, 04:59 UTC. Cost: No application fee stated. A performing organization—not the composer—must apply and commit to the premiere; symphonic requests require at least a 50% match from the organization.
